study_note: Three-seed, 14-million-decision Humanoid Walk policy-init512-to-Gaussian-refinement proposal-schedule ablation against the official-style TD-MPC2 state baseline. At every planner invocation, effective planning iteration 0 contains 512 stochastic policy-prior candidate trajectories and no Gaussian proposals. Its 64 elite trajectories fit TD-MPC2's usual time-indexed diagonal Gaussian; effective iterations 1-7 each draw all 512 proposals from that successively refined Gaussian and contain no policy-prior candidate trajectories. The first 2,500 random seed-collection decisions do not invoke this planner. Terminal trajectory values remain policy-conditioned through Q(z_H, pi(z_H)). All model, optimizer, replay, loss, training, evaluation, population, elite, horizon, temperature, standard-deviation, and configured-iteration settings match configs/dmcontrol/algs/tdmpc2_humanoid_walk_state.json. Candidate evaluation remains 8x512x3 transitions, while policy-trajectory construction raises total planner dynamics transitions from 12,336 to 13,312 per invocation (+7.9%). This is a proposal-schedule intervention rather than a pure policy-count sweep or compute-matched comparison. Distinct W&B metadata identifies this new, unreported planning intervention.
